$comment: Hash of each frozen version's slice in the dump it was blessed from, excluding doc/description/examples (none of which reach the generated output), taken off the parsed dump before generation runs (see lib/dump-digest.mts). Generation fails if a frozen version's slice moves, because its files are skipped and the rest of the tree would be generated against a model they no longer hold. Run `yarn generate:api` and paste what it prints to seed a version. Record $source when you do.
$source: ghcr.io/truenas/middleware:master, middlewared 20260910155922~truenas+1 (digest sha256:28992fdda02450db1fd5f8a72e04a44ef562940b9ec4cb5d45fefd93df60a730, fetched 2026-09-11). Re-seeded together with a regeneration of v25.10.0-v25.10.5 from this same dump, so the hashes and the frozen files describe one model rather than two. Everything the 2026-09-07 seed recorded still holds and is not repeated here; what follows is what moved. The v25.10 slices moved again, and again not because 25.10 changed. Exactly two models differ in substance from the 2026-09-07 dump, in all six slices, S3AccesskeyEntry and SharingS3Entry, and in those slices both occur only under events. Master's S3 models reach them through the unfiltered-event path the previous seed documents: S3AccesskeyEntry gains last_used_at and manage_buckets, and SharingS3Entry gains object_ownership while its permissions_model loses the S3_BUCKET_OWNER_ENFORCED arm — a narrowing as well as three additions, in 25.10 event payloads that no 25.10 server sends. Nothing emitted is affected, since the 25.10 tree declares no SharingS3Entry at all, but a later re-seeder weighing whether a digest move is benign should see the narrowing. The frozen files are unchanged, which is the point of freezing them. SharingNFSEntry also moved in those slices, by a docstring alone, which the digest excludes by design. The pool.dataset.query event fields are still held at the call side's PoolDatasetEntry by hand, and PoolDatasetEntryInput is still the alias that keeps MANIFEST.md honest without exporting a shape 25.10 does not send; src/generated-hand-maintained.spec.ts fails if a regeneration puts either back. No method and no event is removed at any version, and v27.0.0 declares nothing new of its own: everything below lands at v26.0.0 and reaches v27.0.0 by re-export. New: truenas.entitlements.check and truenas.entitlements.info, with EntitlementEntry, EntitlementsInfo, LicenseFeatureEntry, LicenseInfoEntry and Reason behind them, and truenas.license.info's response narrows from Record<string, unknown> | null to LicenseInfoEntry | null. Two type-level removals, both from middleware 375edfbcc9 (NAS-142017, 2026-09-09), which replaced the ad-hoc license predicates with one entitlement engine: system.feature_enabled's parameter widens from the Feature enum to a plain string, so Feature is no longer referenced at v26.0.0 and is no longer exported there or at v27.0.0 (v25.10 keeps its own three-member copy); and AlertCategoryClass loses product_types, which is why v26.0.0 stops redeclaring AlertCategory and AlertCategoryClass and inherits the v25.10.0 pair instead. Eleven S3 types changed shape across middleware 5c3a2af10b (NAS-143453) and a5cbdb997d (NAS-143505): permissions_model loses its S3_BUCKET_OWNER_ENFORCED arm on all four sharing.s3 models and object_ownership arrives beside it, SharingS3Create.dataset becomes optional and nullable, S3Entry and S3Update gain managed_root_dataset, all five access-key models gain manage_buckets, and the three entry-shaped ones (S3AccesskeyEntry, S3AccesskeyEntryInput, S3AccesskeyQueryResultItem) also gain last_used_at. The virt.* namespace and pool.dataset.encryption_algorithm_choices are hand-restored after generation; no dump reproduces either, in any version.
